Wrathbringer : créature sans nom officiel dans le lot. Proposition : « porteurs de colère ».
en: After the sundering of Draenor, most life was wiped out during collapse of the barrier between Draenor and the Twisting Nether and the resulting explosion. The wildlife that survived became sickly or corrupt, and many of Ner'zhul's portals were left permanently open, allowing all manner of dangerous beings to enter Outland and threaten our presence here.  The Wrathbringer population is becoming a real threat. Travel to Invasion Point: Overlord and cull 30 of them.
